records.version: ADULT MOTOKO KUSANAGI2002 SAC: angular adult face, short dark PURPLE/BLUE bob with forward bangs, RED irises, no visor/helmet. Selected modest FIELD TACTICAL outfit: full-coverage fitted charcoal/navy long-sleeve tactical jumpsuit, dark fitted tactical pants, slim gray/black tactical vest/belt, black boots and fingerless gloves. NO underwear/leotard/nudity, no enormous fantasy shoulder armor or glowing circuit tattoo. Compact dark bullpup Seburo C-26A-type physical firearm with forward barrel, two real hands holding its grip/foreend. Distinguish her from long-haired Arise/redcoat and film greenhair designs. Camouflage may be a TINY restrained edge shimmer only; the entire woman stays solid and visible.
